name: Oar
overview: The Scriptures reference oars as essential instruments of navigation and craftsmanship, highlighting their practical and symbolic significance. In Ezekiel 27, oars made from the oaks of Bashan represent the skill and resources invested in seafaring vessels, while the mariners and pilots who handle the oars symbolize those who guide and direct the course of the ships. Isaiah 33 contrasts this by depicting a place where no oars or ships pass, emphasizing God's sovereign protection and peace beyond human endeavor.
